info.name: Box Authorize Authorization Integration Mappings API

variable.description: (Required) An ID of an integration mapping

request.description:
Updates a [Slack integration mapping](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415585987859-Box-as-the-Content-Layer-for-Slack).
Supports updating the Box folder ID and options.

You need Admin or Co-Admin role to
use this endpoint.

response.name: Returns the updated integration mapping object.

Returns a `bad_request` if an incorrect `options` was
supplied or the Box folder cannot be mapped to this `partner_item`.
Error codes:
* `SERVICE_ACCOUNT_IS_NOT_A_COOWNER_OR_OWNER` - service account
  doesn't have co-owner collaboration or is
  not an own
Returns `not_found` if integration mapping object was not found.

You need Admin or Co-Admin role to
use this endpoint.
